title: gmelina evoluta
intro: Gmelina evoluta, commonly known as the White Bauhinia or Snowy Bauhinia, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Gmelina evoluta include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and serve as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
